svg.title: Inside token-release row 14: 3 of 6 diagnostic source components landed, 0 in progress and 3 open. Row 14 remains in progress.
svg.desc: Six diagnostic components explain existing completion/recovery row 14 without adding milestones to the 16-unit, 26-leaf or 46-parent inventories. Stable IDs are F08.4e.7.c.12.1 through F08.4e.7.c.12.6. Source-landed components: 14.1 historical original replay; 14.2 completion-purpose custody; 14.3 commit observation and durable recovery. Open components: 14.4 cold resources and service is NEXT; 14.5 completion state and lookup route; 14.6 authenticated private response. Status words and symbols supplement color, and each component links to its closure criterion. Three landed, zero in progress and three open are diagnostic source counts, not effort estimates or additional parent completions. Parent row 14 remains IN PROGRESS. Overall token release is 13/16 landed, activation 19/26, project 34/46 and production 0/6 verified. Outside this view, row 15 exact committed-original token release and row 16 cold release response/handoff remain open. Historical facts do not renew execution, completion or release authority. Source only: unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned. No whole-row completion, deployed service, token release or current-session claim.
